title: Seed-floor diameter guard uses w²+h² but the grid's widest spacing is (w-1)²+(h-1)² — accepted value 49 can never be satisfied, silently stalling growth
detail: Valid positions span [0,39]×[0,29], so max candidate distance² is 39²+29²=2362, not w²+h²=2500. new_area_seed_tiles=49 (2401<2500) loads clean, yet growth_seed_sep_ok can never pass — every seed window exhausts the 8-attempt budget, the exact silent permanent stall the guard's comment says it rejects.
recommended_fix: Compare seed² against (map_w_tiles-1)² + (map_h_tiles-1)² instead of w²+h², and add a loader test row with new_area_seed_tiles 49 on the 40×30 fixture.
